players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Cal Raleigh sat out Sunday for the 2nd straight day with right-side soreness. He took batting cage swings and had an MRI with no structural damage found. Day-to-day with hopes to return Monday vs Atlanta.

sources.title: Mariners' Cal Raleigh day-to-day with 'general soreness'
Cal Raleigh Injury: Day-to-day with sore side

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper doubled and walked as the Phillies beat Miami 7-2 Sunday. Phillies are at 12-19 but showing offensive life. No injury concerns for Harper, who is slashing .264 with 6 HR.

sources.title: Phillies vs. Marlins Box Score, May 3, 2026

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez sat out Sunday vs Tampa Bay with a right wrist contusion from Saturday's play. He was hit on the hand during a fielding play and is considered day-to-day. He leads the NL with a .303 average.

sources.title: Giants Get Concerning Luis Arraez Update Ahead of Sunday Game

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went 0-for-3 in the Mets' 5-1 win at Anaheim. Big news: Ronny Mauricio broke his left thumb Saturday, potentially opening a return to shortstop for Bichette. He's slashing .226 through 33 games.

sources.title: Mets' Bo Bichette could move to SS with Ronny Mauricio injury

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle delivered two RBI singles in the Tigers' 7-1 series-clinching win over Texas on Sunday Night Baseball. He's slashing .310/.404/.476 with 14 RBI across 33 games and leads AL rookies in multiple categories.

sources.title: Tigers break open close game, earn series win vs. Rangers
Kevin McGonigle News: Swipes base in win

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA doubled in the Cubs' game vs Arizona but reportedly bruised his right knee on a slide Sunday. He is day-to-day with manager Craig Counsell hoping for a Tuesday return.

sources.title: Arizona Diamondbacks vs. Chicago Cubs Box Score, May 3, 2026

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill was out of the Padres lineup Sunday vs White Sox with a LHP starting. He's slashing .200 through the early season but no injury concerns reported.

sources.title: Padres Lineup vs White Sox: Jackson Merrill and Jake Cronenworth Out

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Teoscar went 1-for-4 with a single as Dodgers beat St. Louis 4-1. He's slashing .250 with 4 HR and 17 RBI through 33 games. No injury concerns.

sources.title: Dodgers vs. Cardinals Box Score, May 3, 2026

players.name: Giancarlo Stanton
players.summary: Stanton remains on the 10-day IL (retroactive April 25) with a low-grade calf strain. He was taking batting cage swings Saturday but not cleared to run. Estimated return around May 7 but timeline uncertain.

sources.title: Giancarlo Stanton Calf Injury: Slugger Gives Positive Update

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams did not appear in the Mets' 5-1 win Sunday at Anaheim. He's carried a 7.20 ERA in 12 appearances this year but the Mets have maintained his closer role through the rough stretch.

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler did not start Sunday. He has returned from thoracic outlet surgery with a 2.45 ERA in 11 IP over 2 starts. His velocity is 93-95 mph, slightly below peak, but the Phillies are pleased with his return.

sources.title: Zack Wheeler injury update: Phillies ace making 2026 debut

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans was not scheduled Sunday. He recently struck out 11 in a dominant performance for his first win of 2026 but owns a 5.25 ERA overall in 7 starts. Royals carried 13-19 record into May.

sources.title: Cole Ragans strikes out 11 in first win of 2026

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns was masterful Sunday: 7 shutout innings, 7K, 3H, 1BB — took a shutout into the 8th inning. Reds lost 1-0 when the bullpen gave up the run. Burns now owns a 2.21 ERA in 7 starts — one of the NL's best young arms.

sources.title: Chase Burns throws seven scoreless innings, Reds lose to Pirates

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi did not start Sunday; Rangers used Leiter. He has a 4.76 ERA in 7 starts, struggling with home runs (9 HR through 39 IP). Next start expected mid-week.

sources.title: A Deep Dive Into Nathan Eovaldi's Rocky Season

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan not scheduled Sunday; Wrobleski got the ball and delivered 6 scoreless innings in a 4-1 Dodgers win. The Sheehan vs. Wrobleski rotation battle is intensifying as Sheehan carries a 5.22 ERA.

sources.title: Dave Roberts gives early thoughts on Sheehan, Sasaki & Wrobleski battle

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers not scheduled Sunday; he pitched Saturday (6.1 IP, 8K, 3ER in Angels' 4-3 extra-inning win vs Mets). Season ERA is 4.28 with an excellent 44:9 K:BB across 40 IP.

sources.title: Reid Detmers News: Stumbles late in no-decision
